summary.method: TIER B2: role-call moved to call_moment = earliest instant BOTH legs hold a two-sided book with 0<=spread<=2c dwelled >=10s. Oracle (Tier A) unchanged from V30_READMOMENT_CEILING (4aee323f). Causal signals in [call-180s,call]; role rule D=ask_walk_down - bid_stack - 2*crossed_flag (crossed book bid>=ask => chased); PATIENT=leg with higher D. RACE: on the 179 Tier A events, call_moment vs patient_floor_ts (won if call<=floor). Revised V30 ceiling = Tier A AND tierB2 role-correct AND race-won.

revised_V30_ceiling.definition: Tier A AND tierB2_role_correct AND race_won

DEBIASED_tie_neutral.note: As-run accuracy used tie-break patient-on-tie, auto-scoring all D_p==D_c ties CORRECT. Tie-neutral treats ties (no strict signal differential) as UNCALLABLE. Predicted PATIENT = strictly higher D.
